title: Spaghetti Architect: A Contamination-Resistant, By-Construction-Labelled, Multi-Language Code Dataset Generator
abstract: arXiv:2607.18642v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mined code corpora are abundant but uncontrolled: a snippet's semantics, surface "messiness," and difficulty are whatever the wild contained; there is no known-optimal reference to grade against; and any public sample may already sit in a model's training set. We present Spaghetti Architect, a tool that mints code datasets with the control such corpora lack. An anti-optimization transpiler maps a clean, language-agnostic JSON intermediate representation to deliberately redundant, fully-flattened programs in five languages (Python, JavaScript, Go, Java, C++); every program is compiled, run, and checked against a reference oracle, so each instance is correct by construction. translated_title: Spaghetti Architect（意面架构师）：一个抗污染、构造即标注的多语言代码数据集生成器
translated_abstract: 挖掘得到的代码语料库虽然数量庞大，但缺乏可控性：代码片段的语义、表面“混乱程度”和难度完全取决于野外数据中包含的内容；没有已知最优的参考标准可供评分；而且任何公开样本可能已经存在于模型的训练集中。我们提出了 Spaghetti Architect，这是一个能够生成具有此类语料库所缺乏的可控性的代码数据集的工具。一个反优化转译器将干净的、与语言无关的 JSON 中间表示映射为五种语言（Python、JavaScript、Go、Java、C++）中刻意冗余的、完全扁平化的程序；每个程序都会被编译、运行，并与参考预言机进行核对，因此每个实例在构造上都是正确的。干净的中间表示作为已知最优的参考标准，混乱程度通过严格嵌套的反模式配置文件进行调节，每个实例沿两个正交的难度轴进行标注：内在难度（问题规模）和附带难度（语义固定下的呈现方式），并且污染……
tldr: Spaghetti Architect 通过反优化转译器将干净的中间表示转换为五种语言中刻意冗余的程序，实现了构造即正确、难度可控可标注且抗污染的多语言代码数据集生成。
en_tdlr: Spaghetti Architect generates contamination-resistant, by-construction-correct code datasets in five languages by transpiling a clean intermediate representation into deliberately redundant programs with controllable, labelled difficulty.
